conversation.content: Good morning, I'd like to start our consultation today and get a better understanding of how you're feeling about your condition.

Good morning, doctor. To be honest, I'm feeling somewhat concerned. The idea that I have this chronic illness is quite unsettling. It's impacting my work life, relationships, and leisure time, so it's not easy to manage. I know the treatment might not be needed for years, if at all, but it still feels like a lifelong reality I need to adjust to.
